PUT https://myaccount.table.core.windows.net/mytable(PartitionKey='myPartitionKey', RowKey='myRowKey').
If-Match uses current opaque ETag for optimistic concurrency; mismatch yields 412 Precondition Failed. If-Match:* overrides concurrency. Missing If-Match in version 2011-08-18 or later causes Insert Or Replace (upsert). JSON only for 2015-12-11 or later. This is concurrency behavior, not a separate Azure RBAC permission.
